rows.en: That so?
That's news to me...

Demanding 200,000 for cooking wine that sells
for 500 yen at the supermarket...
You're a classic fake-collision scammer.

Th-The hell it is!
Sh-Show me some proof!!

Then shall we go have a look?
I don't mind one bit...
But if I'm right... you know what happens, right?
Ngh!

There, 500 yen...
Now pick it up and get lost!
Tch! I won't forget this! Ya frizz-head!!
It's DREADLOCKS!!
L-Luis-san...

That was a close one... saved by a hair.
Fitting, for a man with dreadlocks...

...You saved me...
For a moment there, I didn't know what
would happen...

Watch where you're walking...
At this rate, you'll miss the bluebird
of happiness, y'know?

See ya!
Goodbye, baby.
Whoops, sorry, lady...
rows.notes: Luis bumps into a passer-by himself.

rows.en: Watch where you're going!!

(Sigh... I'll just do my shopping
and get home...)

Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...
Whaddya think you're doin', missy?
rows.notes: Female version of c01615 ('oneechan' to a stranger).

rows.en:
If sorry cut it, we wouldn't need cops...
You get that much, don'tcha, missy?
200,000 is a bit much for me...

Hold it, old man.
Nobody pulls the fake-collision scam
these days, y'know?
L-Luis-san!!

Long time no see, Fresh Girl...
Pretty as ever today, I'm glad to see.

Like I care!
I'm talkin' to this girl here!
N-No way! I can't pay that kind of money!!
Fresh Girl, don't let him fool you...

Oh, no. I'm this young lady's guardian.
I can't just look the other way...
(That's Gary-sensei and Luis-san, right...?)

(I thought they were just staring at each other...
Now they're arguing...
Wait, now they're grappling!)

H-Hey!
What are you two doing in a place like this!?

Huh? \p...
What do you want?

Don't stop me, Fresh Boy...
There are times when a man...
just has to fight, y'know?

Pick a better time and place...
If you start brawling in the middle of
the night, someone's gonna call the cops.

Screw the cops!
I'll pound 'em all flat while I'm at it!
You're a teacher, Gary-sensei!

Ha ha ha!
This guy, a teacher?
Don't joke like that, young man...

This curly-headed bastard set record-low scores
on promotion exam after promotion exam.
Who the hell is he supposed to be teaching?

You never even got one shot at a promotion!
That puts you below me, damn it!

I only flew because I wanted to be the wind...
Titles are a load of crap...
That's just running away, plain and simple!
Whaddya say?
Ya wanna go, huh!?
WILL. YOU. BOTH. KNOCK. IT. OFF!!
rows.notes: Japanese spaces out every character for emphasis.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: x80 generic 'hai' (here Gary and Luis, meekly).

rows.en:
What is with you two...
Why are you fighting!?
He's the one picking a fight with me.
He's the one griping about everything I do.
So you two are birds of a feather, then.
We're nothin' alike!

Give me a break!
Fresh Boy or not, there are things you can say
and things you can't, y'know?
Tell me about it...
rows.notes: Also Gary in nml_gry_013 (answering 'That's too bad').

rows.en: So that's the part you agree on.
Shut up!
So why are you even fighting...
This guy won't get out of my way...

It's stupid, but whenever I step right,
he moves right too.

And when I'm nice enough to step left,
he goes out of his way to get in front of me.

That's my line.
You're the one who should be groveling in the dirt.
Wh-What is it?
Him or me, who do you think's in the wrong?
Huh? What are you talking about!?

No, Fresh Boy,
you must choose...
A future with me, or a future with him...
I'd rather pass on both, thanks...
Now choose!!
Gary
Luis
Um, maybe Gary-sensei's right...
Damn right! That's my student!

Now beat it, you dreadlocked,
mustached bastard!
rows.notes: 'doreddo-hige yarou'; glossary describes Luis as mustached.

rows.en: Fresh Boy, this choice is gonna cost you, y'know?

But I'm a generous man...
I'll be waiting for you, anytime, forever...

Ahh, I feel great!
Well, I'm off. Get home soon, you hear!
Oh, okay... Goodbye.
Um, maybe Luis-san's right...

YES!! YES!!
GOOD JOB!!
rows.notes: English in the Japanese; full-width letters made ASCII.

rows.en: Whoa! Please don't hug me!

Tch, you just don't get it...
\p, you just wait till tomorrow.
rows.notes: 'ashita oboete oke yo' = threat of payback tomorrow (Gary is the player's teacher).

rows.en: Go on home, loser dog!

Fresh Boy, now it's party time!
Follow me!!

uncertain: c01685: x80 generic 'hai' rendered 'Yes.'; here Gary and Luis answer meekly after being scolded.
c01719 (and c01729 in slice 24): Luis's 'make-doggu' / 'ruuzu-doggu' rendered 'loser dog' for both genders; the female variant's Engrish 'lose dog' is not reproduced.
c01678: 'tenpa yarou' rendered 'curly-headed bastard' (Gary's hair is not described in the glossary).
